description: Cite-or-abstain ledger for the RECREATIE (recreation development) NormCard corpus, hoofdstuk 9 (Wonen, werken, recreeren) van CVDR704250. Evidence items that failed the verification gate are listed under rejectedEvidence (none: all 2 shard records were verified verbatim against the consolidated text). articlesConsidered lists every H9-article that was reviewed but deliberately did NOT become an evidence record for THIS track; abstentions records the motivated reason per article group. Fase-5-beleid: hoofdstuk 9 bedient meerdere tracks; wonen/werken/stilte-artikelen zijn hier buiten het recreation_development-objecttype en gedekt door de wonen-track (fase 3) en de werken-track (fase 5).
policy: cite-or-abstain: a legal claim becomes a NormCard only with instrument + article + version/date + verbatim quote + URL, all verified. Everything else is recorded here with a reason.

abstentions.reason: Oogmerk/aanwijzing en de overige wonen-paragrafen (9.1-9.21): buiten het recreation_development-objecttype en geformaliseerd in de wonen-track (fase 3, WN-01..12) respectievelijk de werken-track (fase 5, WE-01..06); geen dubbele formalisering.
Stiltegebied-paragraaf: constitutief/doelstellend of gedekt door wonen (9.27/9.29 = WN-11/12) en wind (9.28-context); buiten het recreation_development-objecttype.
